items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I happened to have been staying at a place in California with a guy that's got quite a name, and he played with a name band and that was Juan Tizol, the great trombonist

ctx.x: Well, Willie Best had that apartment, and we used to talk. Well anyway, Lena came over to visit Juan Tizol's wife, Rose, one day, and I was in the house

talking, like we're talking, you know, and she wanted to know what I was doing there. I told her (unintelligible) I got here with Fletcher, and I was getting ready to leave, and she says, "What are you gonna go back?" she says, "I'm getting ready to make a tour," she says. "Why don't you join me?" And I was a little quiet, you know, because it took my breath. She thought I was thinkin' about it. This is funny. So she said, "Come on, let's go in the room and talk." So she took me in the room, and we talked, and…
